data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'munīna', meaning 'to protect'. This name carries a sense of care, guardianship, and nurturing in Islamic culture. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munize usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
